params: @cedric_smile N-\.\.nice finally to meet you! \@cedric_hmm \>...no, wait.
@cedric_sigh It is a pleasure to be of acquaintance at last, Niko.
@niko I'm supposed to be looking for you too!
@cedric_hmm Prototype had contacted me earlier, saying that you would be on your way to the city.
@cedric He sent me a message after his memories were restored.
@cedric_hmm He told me to wait in the city, but I thought it'd be faster for me to pick you guys up.
@cedric_sigh ...Turns out, that was a terrible idea.
@cedric_talk Oh! You mean the flying machine?
@niko_speak They're called planes in my world!
@cedric_sigh ...I did not realize they existed in other worlds...
@niko_speak ...wait! Are you the friend that Calamus and Alula was talking about, then?
@niko_speak Is this the same flying machine they were talking about?
@cedric I do not know anyone named Calamus or Alula.
@cedric_talk I think... they're meant to be friends with my father. \>\n\@cedric_hmm ...in previous iterations of the...
@cedric_talk He was the original owner of the flying machine... \>\n\@cedric_hmm ...it's... one of his greatest inventions, actually.
@cedric_talk But to answer your earlier question... I am proficient in operating the machine.
@cedric_hmm ...but...something weird happened to the engine when I was in the air earlier...
@cedric_sigh I had to make an emergency landing on this tiny island before I crashed into the city wall.
@cedric_sigh It was not pleasant, I will admit.\n\>
@cedric_hmm I wonder if the engine problem has to do with the square particle disruptions...
@cedric I checked, but... there isn't any of that square stuff inside the machine itself.
@cedric_hmm ...but I noticed some islands in the Glen are REALLY messed up now.
@cedric_sigh Sigh. \>\nGuess I should have listened to Proto in the first place.
@cedric_talk He said he was coming with you...
@cedric Is he still back at the main islands?
@niko_upset There was a cave-in...\.\. and then a bunch of squares...
@niko_distressed2 He...\.\. did give me this, though.
@niko3 This disk he pulled from his head...
@cedric_talk He gave you his main drive!
@cedric_hmm As long as I have this, I should be able to bring him back.
@cedric_sigh It's gonna be hard, but yes.
@cedric You need all three of us for the big door.
@cedric_hmm But first thing's first, we need to find a way to go to the city.
@niko_eyeclosed Right...\>\nThe city gate is kind of kaput now.
@cedric2 If this machine was working, we could just fly right in there...
@cedric_hmm I've isolated the issue with the machine, but I can't repair it with the stuff I have on hand.
@cedric The \c[2]battery\c[0] in the engine is dead, and the engine has some \c[2]gears\c[0] that need to be replaced.
@niko ...\>\nDo you think you'll be able to fix it if \p and I help you find those things?
@cedric_sigh Problem is... the Glen isn't exactly a very high-tech area.
@cedric_sigh ...I'm not sure if you'll be able to find anything so specialized here.
@niko_eyeclosed We can't really do anything else right now...
@niko It's from the generator on one of the islands.
@niko_speak It was powering all the robots there...\>\n\@niko_eyeclosed I felt bad for taking it...
@cedric_smile ...we can always just give it back later.
@cedric_hmm We still need a few \c[2]gears\c[0] to put this engine back together.\>\nPlease do what you must to find some.
@niko We found this one in the Barrens.\>\nIt wasn't working at first, but \p and I managed to fix it!
@cedric_smile ...it's good that you thought to bring it with you then.
@cedric_hmm We still need a few \c[2]gears\c[0] to put this engine back together.\>\nPlease do what you must to find some.
@niko It... should have gears in it, right?
@cedric_hmm This looks like one of the ones that my father made.
@niko_pancakes YOUR DAD MAKES MUSIC BOXES TOO?
@cedric_smile My dad makes a lot of things!
@cedric_hmm Where did you get this from, by the way?
@niko_speak A trader from the village gave it to me!
@cedric I see.\>\nI remember father saying that he used to trade with some of the people here.
@cedric_smile He did always love traveling this world, despite...
@cedric_talk The gears in there are compatible with the engine.
@cedric_sigh Although it pains me to have to take it apart...
@cedric We still need a \c[3]battery\c[0] to get this engine running.\>\nPlease do what you must to find one.
@niko What parts do we need to find again?
@cedric We still need a \c[3]battery\c[0] to get this engine running.
@cedric_hmm We still need a few \c[2]gears\c[0] to put this engine back together.
@cedric_hmm A \c[2]battery\c[0] for the engine, and a few \c[2]gears\c[0] to replace the broken ones.
@cedric If you could find me the parts I need, I should be able to get this machine off the ground again.
@calamus C'mon, Alula.\>\nLet's go pay our respects...
@calamus_smile2 At least I still got my sister...
@calamus_sad Alula....\.\.\n\@calamus_smile wanna help me look for some flowers for mom later?
@calamus We're just about done here, so let us know when you want to go back to the ruins.
@niko Hey, do you know where I could find a battery?
@calamus_heh We...\.\. don't really use electricity in the Glen.
@calamus_speak Oh, but there are robots at the research station!\>\nIf there's a battery anywhere, they'd know where it is.
@alula_speak I hope she can see us wherever she is!
@alula_gasp MOM YOU'RE NOT GONNA BELIEVE WHAT HAPPENED TODAY WE MET THE MESSIAH AND
@alula_speak Gears!\>\n\@alula Didja find any of those?
@niko No, but... I found this music box though!
@niko Do you know where I could find some gears?
@niko_speak It's like...\.\. A metal circle thing with teeth!
@alula_speak Haha, that sounds so silly!\>\nLike something Magpie would have!
@alula He collects all kinds of funny stuff!
@alula_speak I mean, he even keeps around broken glass and junk!
@niko_speak ...Oh yeah!\>\n\@niko I think I know who you're talking about.
@cedric_smile Looks like the flying machine has a chance after all!
@cedric I just have to assemble the pieces now, but it might take a while...
@cedric_smile Do you mind keeping me company?
@cedric_hmm The connectors in the battery were not designed for this type of engine, so I have to shift around some of these ports.
@cedric_sigh ...and there's this bolt that keeps getting stuck, and...
@cedric_smile ...don't worry! I am making decent progress!
@cedric We should be able to make it to the city by tonight.
@niko3 ...what...\.\. will happen once we get there?
@cedric_hmm We need to bring Proto back first.
@cedric_talk And then we need to go find one more person.
@cedric You may have already met her, actually...
@cedric_talk Do you remember her from the last time you were in this world?
@cedric2 This is going to sound strange, but...
@niko_eyeclosed The memories are still really blurry, though...
@niko_eyeclosed I.... DO remember talking to a fox at one point...
@niko_eyeclosed The memories are still really blurry, though...
@niko_eyeclosed I... don't think I know what you're talking about.
@cedric_talk Even if she IS the least hidden one of us...
@niko_eyeclosed My memories are still really blurry, though...
@niko_eyeclosed Proto told me to think of this world like a dream.
@niko_distressed2 But then I get so caught up with...
@niko_distressed2 I forget that everything here is supposed to be...\.\.not real...
@niko_eyeclosed ...and then I just get really sad...
@niko_upset2 ...I know this is for me to go home, but...
@niko_upset Knowing that none of it mattered in the first place...
@niko_eyeclosed ...am I just\.\. trapped here for no reason...?
@niko_eyeclosed Proto also told me to not ask anyone in the world about this...
@niko_eyeclosed Aren't you guys ALL supposed to be code?
@niko_eyeclosed I'm not sure what to even believe anymore...
@cedric3 She's SO much better at explaining this sort of thing.
@cedric_sigh I'm doing a terrible job of it!
@cedric_sigh2 I bet Proto was even less tactful, wasn't he...
@cedric_sigh I'm afraid I must risk sounding callous, but...
@cedric2 ...please, you need not concern yourself with how "real" everything is, for now.
@cedric_talk The plan is already in motion, we cannot allow for distractions.
@cedric_hmm Father is putting everything into this one last run of the world.
@cedric_sigh The last chance for him to fix everything.
@niko2 Your father... is involved in the World Machine?
@cedric_sigh The acceleration of square particle anomalies was not accounted for at all, though.
@cedric The patch was only built to accomodate the normal rate they appear, but...
@cedric2 Thankfully, he gave you the disk just in time.
@niko3 So... what happened to him anyway?
@niko3 What happens  to...\.\. ANYONE who gets caught in the squares?
@cedric_hmm Well, you know how the simulation works, right?
@cedric Specifically, everything is generated from pre-existing code.
@cedric The squares can cause damage to that code...
@cedric_sigh Father has lost some friends in previous iterations of the simulation.
@cedric3 It took him forever to develop the current, much more stable version.
@niko4 ...you're making it sound like...\.\. your dad built the simulation himself...
@niko_what If everyone in this world is code...
@cedric_sigh2 ...like I said, you shouldn't concern yourself with...
@cedric3 Did Prototype....\.\. ever tell you about the old world?
@niko3 He... DID say something about being built to greet the messiah of the old world.
@niko_eyeclosed I was um...\.\. too caught up with the other stuff at the time to think about it...
@cedric2 Ah, you know OF it at least, then.
@cedric My father... myself... the other two...
@cedric3 None of us are part of the simulation itself.
@cedric_sigh Our home world....\>the "real" world... \.\.was actually destroyed a long time ago.
@cedric In the years leading up to the calamity, scientists from all over the world tried to stop it, but the outlook was bleak.
@cedric A vague prophecy about a messiah from another world became everyone's last bastion of hope.
@cedric3 Prophetbot....\.\.er, Prototype... \.\.was built to predict the future, about the specifics of this messiah.
@cedric_sigh2 But as his predictions turned out, the messiah would not have been able to arrive to our world in time.
@cedric4 In fact, the messiah would not even have been born before our world ended.
@cedric Disheartened, most people abandoned their research and resolved to peacefully live out their final years.
@cedric3 But... some people did the opposite.
@cedric_sigh Even though saving the world was impossible, they didn't want our existence to be in vain.
@cedric2 And that's...\.\. where my father came in.
@cedric_talk With the last of his resources...\>\nhe built his most ambitious project yet.
@cedric2 A large, detailed facsimile of the old world, generated from a pool of memories collected from everyone he knew.
@cedric4 ...after a heavy amount of modification and an added narrative, my father was able to convert the entire structure into code.
@niko3 ...how did that code.... escape the old world?
@cedric What I do know is, there is no equipment back home that was powerful enough to run the code independently.
@cedric So, asides from the standard hardware, it also needed to borrow the mental processing abilities of a living person.
@cedric Father used himself for that, during the initial testing phases.
@cedric2 Like I said, it took many iterations for him to make the experience stable enough.
@cedric_sigh2 ...but as you can see, even that's breaking down.
@cedric Father caught on to the issue in the last minute, but did not have enough time to fix it.
@cedric4 After the world ended...\.\. the code kinda just ended up...\>\n\@cedric3 floating in the void, indefinitely.
@cedric_sigh ...waiting for a willing operator to install it onto their own hardware.
@cedric The operator... \.\.\p.... \.\.would then generate the universe using the code, becoming god in the process.
@niko So... \p was the living person you needed to borrow?
@niko_eyeclosed (I... should've asked that question a long time ago, shouldn't I...)
@niko_eyeclosed Looks like a piece from this plane.
